entries.title: A note on Nyman's equivalent formulation of the Riemann Hypothesis
entries.journal_ref: Algebraic Methods in Probability and Statistics, Viana M. & Richards D. eds, Contemp. Math. 287, 23-26, American Mathematical Society, Providence, RI, 2001
entries.summary: A certain subspace of the Hilbert space of square-integrable functions on the unit interval has been considered by Nyman, Beurling, and others, with the result that the constant function 1 belongs to it if and only if the Riemann Hypothesis holds. I show that the product of |1 - 1/rho| taken over the zeros with real parts strictly greater than 1/2, counted with multiplicities, is the norm of the projection of 1 to this subspace. This provides a quantitative refinement to Nyman's theorem.

entries.title: An adelic causality problem related to abelian L-functions
entries.summary: I associate to a global field K a Lax-Phillips scattering which has the property of causality if and only if the Riemann Hypothesis holds for all the abelian L-functions of K. As a Hilbert space closure problem this provides an adelic variation on a theme initiated by Nyman and Beurling. The adelic aspects are related to previous work by Tate, Iwasawa and Connes.

entries.title: A lower bound in an approximation problem involving the zeros of the Riemann zeta function
entries.summary: We slightly improve the lower bound of Baez-Duarte, Balazard, Landreau and Saias in the Nyman-Beurling formulation of the Riemann Hypothesis as an approximation problem. We construct Hilbert space vectors which could prove useful in the context of the so-called `Hilbert-Polya idea'.

entries.title: On an analytic estimate in the theory of the Riemann Zeta function and a Theorem of Baez-Duarte
entries.summary: We establish a uniform upper estimate for the values of zeta(s)/zeta(s+A), 0<= A, on the critical line (conditionally on the Riemann Hypothesis). We use this to give a variant, purely complex analytic, to Baez-Duarte's proof of a strengthened Nyman-Beurling criterion for the validity of the Riemann Hypothesis.
